1.w: For the music director, by the Korahites; according to the alamoth style; a song. God is our strong refuge; he is truly our helper in times of trouble.

2.w: For this reason we do not fear when the earth shakes, and the mountains tumble into the depths of the sea,

3.w: when its waves crash and foam, and the mountains shake before the surging sea. (Selah)

4.w: The river’s channels bring joy to the city of God, the special, holy dwelling place of the Most High.

5.w: God lives within it, it cannot be moved. God rescues it at the break of dawn.

6.w: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms are overthrown. God gives a shout, the earth dissolves.

7.w: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is on our side. The God of Jacob is our stronghold. (Selah)

8.w: Come, Witness the exploits of the Lord, who brings devastation to the earth.

9.w: He brings an end to wars throughout the earth. He shatters the bow and breaks the spear; he burns the shields with fire.

10.w: He says, “Stop your striving and recognize that I am God. I will be exalted over the nations! I will be exalted over the earth!”

11.w: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is on our side! The God of Jacob is our stronghold! (Selah)
